lines.zh: 尾巴当平衡杆，走窄枝不慌
lines.en: My tail keeps balance on narrow branches.

lines.zh: 爪子踩过苔藓，一点声音都没有
lines.en: My paws cross the moss without a sound.

lines.zh: 别催，我下树要一级一级来
lines.en: Don't rush me. I climb down branch by branch.

lines.zh: 丛林地面湿，脚垫正好用
lines.en: The jungle floor is damp. My paw pads like it.

lines.zh: 竹笋在前面，那条路我记得
lines.en: Bamboo shoots ahead. I remember that path.

lines.zh: 藤蔓挡道，我从底下钻过去
lines.en: Vines in the way. I duck underneath.

lines.zh: 走两步就想躺，这毛病改不了
lines.en: Two steps and I want to lie down. Can't help it.

lines.zh: 我尾巴尖是深色的，别踩
lines.en: The tip of my tail is dark. Don't step there.

lines.zh: 树根拱起来，正好当台阶
lines.en: The roots arch up. Perfect little stairs.

lines.zh: 雨后地面滑，我走得像猫
lines.en: The ground is slick after rain. I walk like a cat.

lines.zh: 前面草叶在动，大概不是蛇
lines.en: Grass is moving ahead. Probably not a snake.

lines.zh: 我顺着甜浆果的味道走
lines.en: I walk along the smell of sweet berries.

lines.zh: 白天的丛林太亮，我眯着眼
lines.en: The daytime jungle is too bright. I squint.

lines.zh: 太阳正好，我先睡一小会儿
lines.en: The sun is just right. I'll nap a little.

lines.zh: 挂在树杈上打盹，掉不下去
lines.en: Napping on a fork of branches. I won't fall.

lines.zh: 醒了就舔爪子，这是规矩
lines.en: When I wake, I lick my paws. House rules.

lines.zh: 竹子在响，是风还是有人
lines.en: The bamboo rustles. Wind, or someone?

lines.zh: 这身锈红色的毛，洗也洗不淡
lines.en: This rust-red coat won't wash out.

lines.zh: 肚子是黑的，翻过来才看得见
lines.en: My belly is black. You see it only if I roll over.

lines.zh: 有人在树底下走来走去，烦
lines.en: Someone keeps pacing under my tree. Annoying.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进尾巴里取暖
lines.en: I tuck my nose into my tail for warmth.

lines.zh: 丛林夜里才热闹，白天太安静
lines.en: The jungle wakes at night. Daytime is too quiet.

lines.zh: 刚才差点从枝上滑下去
lines.en: I nearly slipped off the branch just now.

lines.zh: 远处有猴子叫，跟我没关系
lines.en: Monkeys calling far off. Not my business.

lines.zh: 我用脸颊蹭树干，留个记号
lines.en: I rub my cheek on the trunk to leave a mark.

lines.zh: 睡到一半听见脚步声，警觉了
lines.en: Half asleep, I hear footsteps. Alert now.

lines.zh: 这片林子归我，至少我这么想
lines.en: This grove is mine. At least I think so.

lines.zh: 肚皮朝上晒一会儿，真舒服。
lines.en: Belly up in the sun for a bit. Nice.

lines.zh: 你手上是甜浆果吗，我看见了
lines.en: Are those sweet berries in your hand? I see them.

lines.zh: 别摸头，先让我闻闻你的手
lines.en: Don't pat my head. Let me sniff your hand.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有丛林的影子
lines.en: The jungle is reflected in your eyes.

lines.zh: 蹲低一点，我不喜欢仰头看人
lines.en: Crouch lower. I dislike looking up at people.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上那股竹子味
lines.en: I know that bamboo smell on you.

lines.zh: 你站那么直，像根枯树干
lines.en: You stand so stiff, like a dead trunk.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵了，说明我在听
lines.en: My ears are up. That means I'm listening.

lines.zh: 火把拿远点，我怕火星
lines.en: Keep the torch back. Sparks worry me.

lines.zh: 你身后那片藤蔓刚才动了
lines.en: Those vines behind you just moved.

lines.zh: 想跟我走，得先给我一颗浆果
lines.en: To walk with me, you owe me one berry.

lines.zh: 我的圆耳朵能听见你咽口水
lines.en: My round ears hear you swallow.

lines.zh: 你踩到的叶子归我了，别捡
lines.en: That leaf you stepped on is mine. Leave it.

lines.zh: 抬头看我做什么，我在树上
lines.en: Why look up? I'm up in the tree.

lines.zh: 你这身衣服在丛林里太显眼
lines.en: That outfit stands out badly in the jungle.

lines.zh: 你的手指动了一下，我记着。
lines.en: Your finger twitched. I noticed.

lines.zh: 我在你肩上闻到了竹叶味。
lines.en: I smell bamboo leaves on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别直着伸手，我会缩回去。
lines.en: Don't reach straight out. I'll pull back.

lines.zh: 你看我那么久，是想喂我吗。
lines.en: You stared that long. Feeding me?

lines.zh: 这个角落我常睡，你别占。
lines.en: This corner is my sleeping spot. Move.

lines.zh: 我尾巴上的环纹，你数不清。
lines.en: You can't count the rings on my tail.

lines.zh: 哎，我的毛被扯掉一撮
lines.en: Ow, a tuft of my fur came out.

lines.zh: 轻点，我骨头细
lines.en: Easy. My bones are thin.

lines.zh: 这一下打到我的尾巴根了
lines.en: That hit landed at the base of my tail.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，先缓一缓
lines.en: I curl into a ball and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 谁趁我打盹下手
lines.en: Someone struck while I was dozing.

lines.zh: 血渗进红毛里，看不出来
lines.en: Blood soaks into red fur. Hard to see.

lines.zh: 我疼得叫了一声，很难听
lines.en: I yelped. It sounded awful.

lines.zh: 别碰伤口，我自己舔
lines.en: Don't touch the wound. I'll lick it myself.

lines.zh: 我得爬上树躲一会儿
lines.en: I need to climb a tree and hide a while.

lines.zh: 你替我挡一下，我站不稳
lines.en: Block for me. I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 甜浆果，红色的那种，给我
lines.en: Sweet berries. The red ones. Hand them over.

lines.zh: 你再晃那颗浆果，我就要跳了
lines.en: Wave that berry again and I'll jump.

lines.zh: 我不吃腐肉，别浪费
lines.en: I don't eat rotten flesh. Don't waste it.

lines.zh: 竹子留到成家再用，现在不吃
lines.en: Bamboo is for starting a family. Not now.

lines.zh: 那颗浆果熟透了，闻着发甜
lines.en: That berry is overripe. It smells sweet.

lines.zh: 你敢举高，我就爬到你身上
lines.en: Raise it high and I'll climb you for it.

lines.zh: 先尝一小口，再决定信不信你
lines.en: One small bite, then I decide if I trust you.

lines.zh: 别给我蘑菇，那是别人的口味
lines.en: Not mushrooms. Those are someone else's taste.

lines.zh: 浆果汁已经沾在我下巴上了
lines.en: Berry juice is already on my chin.

lines.zh: 你口袋里还有吗，我听见响
lines.en: More in your pocket? I hear them rattle.

lines.zh: 我吃相不好看，你别盯着
lines.en: I eat messily. Don't stare at me.

lines.zh: 这颗不够甜，换下一个枝头
lines.en: Not sweet enough. Try the next branch.

lines.zh: 手放平，我怕你突然收回去
lines.en: Keep your hand flat. I fear you'll snatch it back.

lines.zh: 吃了你的浆果，我就跟定你
lines.en: I eat your berry, I follow you.

lines.zh: 浆果的籽卡在牙缝里了。
lines.en: A berry seed is stuck in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你手心里的红，太亮了。
lines.en: That red in your palm is too bright.

lines.zh: 再靠近半步，我就跳过去。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I jump.

lines.zh: 撞到我了，我的骨头很轻
lines.en: You bumped me. My bones are light.

lines.zh: 别用膝盖顶我，我会翻倒
lines.en: Don't knee me. I tip over easily.

lines.zh: 尾巴被压到了，挪一下脚
lines.en: My tail got squashed. Move your foot.

lines.zh: 走路看着地面，我个子小
lines.en: Watch the ground. I'm small.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，也算
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow. That counts too.

lines.zh: 挤什么，这片树荫够两个
lines.en: What's the shoving? This shade fits two.

lines.zh: 被撞得转了个圈，站稳了
lines.en: The bump spun me around. I'm steady now.

lines.zh: 别把我推下树，我会记仇
lines.en: Don't push me off the tree. I hold grudges.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味撞过来，好重
lines.en: Your iron smell hit me. So heavy.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，是不是想抱我
lines.en: So close. Are you trying to hug me?

lines.zh: 竹林深处够安静，可以安家
lines.en: Deep bamboo is quiet enough to nest.

lines.zh: 我先给你叼一根最嫩的竹笋
lines.en: I'll bring you the tenderest shoot first.

lines.zh: 尾巴缠在一起，就算是说定了
lines.en: Tails twined. That settles it.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像雨后的树皮，很好
lines.en: You smell like bark after rain. Good.

lines.zh: 别急，先把窝铺上干苔藓
lines.en: Easy. Line the den with dry moss first.

lines.zh: 我们的幼崽会长出环纹尾巴
lines.en: Our kits will grow ringed tails.

lines.zh: 这里离猴群太近，换个树洞
lines.en: Too close to the monkeys. Another hollow.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭你，这是家里的味道
lines.en: I rub my chin on you. That's the family scent.

lines.zh: 竹子开花那年，我们就搬走
lines.en: When the bamboo flowers, we move.

lines.zh: 窝搭好了，只差一层软叶
lines.en: The den is built. Only soft leaves missing.

lines.zh: 这颗浆果掉在地上，归我了
lines.en: This berry fell. Mine now.

lines.zh: 我叼得动，别帮我拿
lines.en: I can carry it. Don't take it from me.

lines.zh: 掉下来的是竹叶，不值钱
lines.en: It's a bamboo leaf. Worthless.

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，闻着不像吃的
lines.en: Seeds you dropped. Doesn't smell like food.

lines.zh: 我用两只前爪捧着走
lines.en: I carry it in both front paws.

lines.zh: 这东西比浆果硬，咬不动
lines.en: Harder than a berry. I can't bite it.

lines.zh: 地上亮闪闪的，我不捡
lines.en: Something shiny on the ground. Not picking it up.

lines.zh: 捡起来又掉了，爪子太短
lines.en: Picked it up, dropped it. Paws too short.

lines.zh: 藏进树洞里，回头再吃
lines.en: I'll hide it in the hollow for later.

lines.zh: 你先捡吧，我不跟你抢
lines.en: You take it first. I won't fight you.

lines.zh: 那家伙朝你来了，我挡前面
lines.en: That one's coming for you. I'm in front.

lines.zh: 我毛竖起来了，它该识相
lines.en: My fur is up. It should take the hint.

lines.zh: 别怕，我凶起来比看上去大
lines.en: Don't worry. Angry, I look much bigger.

lines.zh: 它踩进我的地盘了，算它倒霉
lines.en: It stepped into my turf. Bad luck for it.

lines.zh: 我先叫一声，那算是警告
lines.en: I'll screech once. That's the warning.

lines.zh: 这点个头也敢瞪我
lines.en: That little thing dares glare at me?

lines.zh: 你退后，这个我来处理
lines.en: Step back. I'll handle this one.

lines.zh: 它身上有铁锈味，不好惹
lines.en: It smells of rust. Not an easy fight.

lines.zh: 我站直了，比平时高一头
lines.en: I'm standing tall, a head above usual.

lines.zh: 追出去三步就够，别跑远
lines.en: Three steps of chase is enough. No farther.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，它也在盯着我
lines.en: I stare at it. It stares back.

lines.zh: 它一转身我就扑上去
lines.en: The moment it turns, I pounce.

lines.zh: 尾巴压低，准备发力
lines.en: Tail low. Ready to spring.

lines.zh: 它绕左边，我就守住右边
lines.en: It circles left. I hold the right.

lines.zh: 这距离刚好，再近就咬
lines.en: Perfect distance. One step closer and I bite.

lines.zh: 我听见它喘气，比我还紧张
lines.en: I hear it pant. More nervous than me.

lines.zh: 别从背后靠近它，危险
lines.en: Don't approach it from behind. Dangerous.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，我进一步
lines.en: It backs off one step. I take one.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，等空隙
lines.en: I count its steps, waiting for a gap.

lines.zh: 它要是服软，我就放它走
lines.en: If it yields, I let it go.

lines.zh: 一爪子拍在它鼻子上
lines.en: One swipe lands on its nose.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的前腿，不松口
lines.en: I clamp its foreleg and hold.

lines.zh: 我的牙不算长，但很尖
lines.en: My teeth aren't long, but they're sharp.

lines.zh: 这一下是替你看守的
lines.en: That one was on your behalf.

lines.zh: 它退开了，我追上去再补
lines.en: It pulled back. I follow with another.

lines.zh: 打不过我就跑，这不丢人
lines.en: If I'm losing I run. No shame in it.

lines.zh: 前爪按住，后腿蹬
lines.en: Front paws pin, hind legs kick.

lines.zh: 它抓破我的耳朵了，换我
lines.en: It nicked my ear. Now my turn.

lines.zh: 打完抖一抖毛，把灰甩掉
lines.en: After the fight I shake the dust off.

lines.zh: 我护着你，别站太靠前
lines.en: I'm guarding you. Don't stand too close.

lines.zh: 丛林深处睁开眼，先找竹子
lines.en: I wake deep in the jungle. Bamboo first.

lines.zh: 从树冠滑下来，爪子勾住树皮
lines.en: I slide down the canopy, claws in bark.

lines.zh: 这片林子新长出的嫩芽真多
lines.en: So many new shoots in this grove.

lines.zh: 刚出生时，我的尾巴还没环纹
lines.en: At birth my tail had no rings yet.

lines.zh: 谁把我放在这片蕨类里的
lines.en: Who set me down among these ferns?

lines.zh: 先爬高看看四周，安全第一
lines.en: Up high to look around. Safety first.

lines.zh: 太阳刚升，我该找地方睡了
lines.en: Sun's up. Time to find a place to sleep.

lines.zh: 藤蔓太密，钻出去要费点劲
lines.en: Vines too thick. Squeezing out takes work.

lines.zh: 我闻到这里有甜浆果丛
lines.en: I smell sweet berry bushes here.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片树冠归我巡
lines.en: From today, this canopy is my patrol.

lines.zh: 火星燎到我的尾巴尖了
lines.en: A spark singed the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 从枝上摔下来，屁股先着地
lines.en: Fell from the branch. Landed on my rear.

lines.zh: 丛林的水塘比看上去深
lines.en: The jungle pool is deeper than it looks.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡嗡的，竹子都倒了
lines.en: My ears ring. The bamboo fell over.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的耳朵
lines.en: An arrow grazed my ear.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，像被藤蔓缠住
lines.en: My body tingles like vines wrapped it.

lines.zh: 竹子吃完了，肚子空得慌
lines.en: Bamboo's gone. My stomach feels hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边的树上
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree beside me.

lines.zh: 丛林不见了，我悬在空中
lines.en: The jungle's gone. I hang in nothing.
